column `composition` (element fractions as a compact formula string) and

  - V (fraction in [0, 0.9918])
  - Zn (fraction in [0, 1])
  - Ni (fraction in [0, 0.6])

Reason from the training data, then end with your explicit proposal, e.g.

turns.answer_text:
The closest bracketing samples composed only of the permitted elements are:

- `Y0.6Ca0.4Ba1.2La0.8Cu3O7.15`, Tc = 67 K
- `Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O10`, Tc = 110 K

Interpolating their normalized element fractions with weight \(23/43\) on the 110 K sample gives an estimated Tc of exactly:

\[
(20/43)(67)+(23/43)(110)=90\text{ K}.
\]

The proposed fractions sum to 1 and satisfy all bounds.

Final: O=0.567533407, Cu=0.169037674, Ba=0.042444071, Sr=0.062927497, Y=0.021222036, Ca=0.045611772, La=0.028296047, Bi=0.062927497, Fe=0, Nb=0, C=0, Pr=0, As=0, B=0, Pb=0, Ce=0, Mo=0, V=0, Zn=0, Ni=0
